info.name: Amplitude Attribution Annotations User Activity API

params.name: user
params.description: The user_id to look up activity for.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for pagination. Default is 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of events to return. Default is 1000.

items.docs: Get a user's most recent events, with optional filters on event types. Returns up to 1000 of the most recent events for a given user.

params.name: user
params.description: The user_id, device_id, or Amplitude ID to search for.

items.docs: Search for a user by user_id, device_id, or Amplitude ID. Returns matching user identifiers and their most recent event details.
